cpu_identity.note: Closes finding M-03 of the amendment review. The previous record held only "AMD64 Family 23 Model 160", which does not name the processor. The marketing name is now measured, not inferred. REVIEW-07 concerns a Ryzen 5 7520U latency claim and this host is that processor, so the TASK-06 benchmark belongs here. It is still a FRESH measurement, not a recovery of the historical 145 ms.
